steps.say: This is LeadAgent. A WhatsApp assistant that helps small businesses in India capture and manage their leads.
The business owner signs in with their WhatsApp number.
And a dashboard password. Passwords are hashed, and every form is protected.
Here are all the leads. Each lead has a status, tags, and a full activity log.
Owners can search, edit, export to CSV, or sync everything to Google Sheets.
Leads arrive from WhatsApp chats, website forms, or tools like Zapier. The AI agent handles the rest, and asks for a yes before sending anything.
